Then I won’t pretend there’s some hidden good version of that silence you’re forgetting. If it’s only ever meant bad, of course your stomach braces — your body has learned the pattern.

Given that, maybe tonight’s goal isn’t surviving her reaction. It’s getting through the call without handing her more than you can afford to. Something like: “I’m staying with a friend. I’m safe. I’m not getting into the rest on the phone.”

That’s true. It’s incomplete, but it isn’t a lie. Does that feel survivable to say, or does it still feel like you’re setting off the math?
